snippet.title: I Added FAST FREDBEAR To Hello Neighbor
snippet.description:
Steam: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3596777736
Moddb: https://www.moddb.com/mods/fredbear-runaway/downloads/fredbearrunaway-patch-1
SdaltMods: https://sites.google.com/view/hello-neighbor-sdalt-mods?usp=sharing

This mod is based off of Fredbear from Those Nights at Fredbear's: The 2015 Remake by Salamance. This mod switches the neighbor into a super fast Fredbear - no custom levels except for instructions. The name is Freadbear Runaway.

#helloneighbor 
#fnaf 
#mods
